summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct clerical errors in an original 8-K, announcing that its Board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $500,000 over 12 months. The program permits open-market or other lawful repurchases, subject to CFO approval based on liquidity and cash requirements; the company cites meaningful undervaluation. No specific price, premium, or advisor named. The filing is an amendment correcting dates to August 17 and 18, 2026. Watch for execution pace and potential buyback-induced support for the stock price; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a routine capital return authorization.
